Politics · India

Kangana Ranaut Scolds Officials Over Development Work Delays

Bharatiya Janata Party MP Kangana Ranaut reprimanded officials in Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, during a District Development Coordination and Monitoring Committee (Disha) meeting. She expressed strong dissatisfaction with the slow pace of development work and the implementation of government schemes. Ranaut specifically criticized the slow utilization of her MP fund, stating that only approximately ₹50 lakh had been spent out of ₹11 crore available. She demanded a performance report on expenditures and highlighted pending development projects.
